hints.title: Membership Fast Filtering
hints.text: The jewels string defines which stone types are precious. Determining whether a stone is a jewel requires checking each stone against the precious collection.

hints.title: Constant Time Membership Invariant
hints.text: Storing all jewel characters in an easily queryable collection permits constant time lookup for each character in the stones string.

hints.title: Lookup And Counter Accumulation Procedure
hints.text: Construct a collection of jewel characters. Traverse each character in stones, checking if it exists within the jewel collection. If it does, increment a counter. Return the final count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(J + S) time and O(J) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning jewels linearly for every stone takes O(J * S) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Building a set of jewels takes O(J) space and allows O(1) checks per stone, running in O(J + S) total time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice case sensitivity (letters are case sensitive) and provide the optimal linear time solution.
